scenes.location: Hamack town, including the hotel, shops, bar counter, and street.
scenes.storyState: The party is in Hamack gathering information; optional services and a delivery job are available before the spaceport lead.
scenes.purpose: Translate directly reachable shop, hotel, drink, fortune, delivery job, and menu interactions.
previousContext: The party reached Hamack while looking for Joe and information about Lucia.
followingContext: The bar informant provides a possible spaceport/Mars lead; the optional job has its own branches.
branchAlternatives: Records are independent service interactions or conditional job outcomes. The menu entries are selector labels, not spoken lines.
evidence: Fresh source replay and RE-confirmed Hamack exterior objects; all listed objects are on the reachable town route.
uncertainty: Fortune descriptions are impressions and may not establish objective character traits.
The item term is rendered canonically as canned food; UI display label may be abbreviated.
notes: Only direct Hamack route service interactions are included.
scenes.reviewNote: Read all entries with their map/branch context. Distinguish menu labels from dialogue, preserve the exact job delivery objective and fortune randomness, and keep hotel charges in credits.
